title: Ravana reprimands Shuka and Sarana
introduction: Ravana reprimands Shuka and Sarana, asking them to leave the assembly. He again sends some spies to the place of Rama and Lakshmana. Those spies were got caught by Vibhishana and the monkeys start harassing them. But the compassionate Rama gets them released and the spies reach back Lanka.
closing:
शुकेन तु समाख्यातांस् तान् दृष्ट्वा हरि यूथपान् |
 लक्ष्मणम् च महावीर्यम् भुजम् रामस्य दक्षिणम् || २-२९-१
 समीपस्थम् च रामस्य भ्रातरम् स्वम् विभीषणम् |
 सर्व वानर राजम् च सुग्रीवम् भीम विक्रमम् || २-२९-२
 अङ्गदम् चापि बलिनम् वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् |
 हनूमन्तम् च विक्रान्तम् जाम्बवन्तम् च दुर्जयम् || २-२९-३
 सुषेणम् कुमुदम् नीलम् नलम् च प्लवगर्षभम् |
 गजम् गवाक्षम् शरभम् वैन्दम् च द्विविदम् तथा || २-२९-४
 किंचिद् आविग्न हृदयो जात क्रोधः च रावणः |
 भर्त्सयाम् आस तौ वीरौ कथा अन्ते शुक सारणौ || २-२९-५
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 29th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
अधो मुखौ तौ प्रणताव् अब्रवीत् शुक सारणौ |
रोष गद्गदया वाचा सम्रब्धः परुषम् वचः
verses.iast:
adho mukhau tau praṇatāv abravīt śuka sāraṇau |
roṣa gadgadayā vācā samrabdhaḥ paruṣam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Ravana spoke (the following) excited and harsh words, in a voice choked in anger to Shuka and Sarana who stood saluting with their faces bent down.

verses.devanagari:
न तावत् सदृशम् नाम सचिवैर् उपजीविभिः |
विप्रियम् नृपतेर् वक्तुम् निग्रह प्रग्रहे विभोः
verses.iast:
na tāvat sadṛśam nāma sacivair upajīvibhiḥ |
vipriyam nṛpater vaktum nigraha pragrahe vibhoḥ
verses.translation: "It is not befitting to utter unpleasant words by dependent ministers to their king who has the power to mete out any punishment or reward."

verses.devanagari:
रिपूणाम् प्रतिकूलानाम् युद्ध अर्थम् अभिवर्तताम् |
उभाभ्याम् सदृशम् नाम वक्तुम् अप्रस्तवे स्तवम्
verses.iast:
ripūṇām pratikūlānām yuddha artham abhivartatām |
ubhābhyām sadṛśam nāma vaktum aprastave stavam
verses.translation: "Is it proper for both of you to shower irrelevant praise on our enemies who are adverse to us and are approaching for a war?"

verses.devanagari:
आचार्या गुरवो वृद्धा वृथा वाम् पर्युपासिताः |
सारम् यद् राज शास्त्राणाम् अनुजीव्यम् न गृह्यते
verses.iast:
ācāryā guravo vṛddhā vṛthā vām paryupāsitāḥ |
sāram yad rāja śāstrāṇām anujīvyam na gṛhyate
verses.translation: "In vain have you sat at the feet of your elders, your preceptors and the aged, since the essence to be followed from political sciences has not been grasped by both of you."

glosses.meaning: have you sat at the feet

verses.devanagari:
गृहीतो वा न विज्ञातो भारो ज्ञानस्य वा उच्यते |
ईदृशैः सचिवैर् युक्तो मूर्खैर् दिष्ट्या धरामि अहम्
verses.iast:
gṛhīto vā na viGYāto bhāro GYānasya vā ucyate |
īdṛśaiḥ sacivair yukto mūrkhair diṣṭyā dharāmi aham
verses.translation: "Or if you have imbibed them, you have not remembered them. You are over-burdened with ignorance! Being associated with such foolish ministers, it is a miracle that I am still able to retain my sovereignty."

glosses.meaning: or if you have imbibed them
I am able to retain my sovereignity.

verses.devanagari:
किम् नु मृत्योर् भयम् न अस्ति माम् वक्तुम् परुषम् वचः |
यस्य मे शासतो जिह्वा प्रयच्चति शुभ अशुभम्
verses.iast:
kim nu mṛtyor bhayam na asti mām vaktum paruṣam vacaḥ |
yasya me śāsato jihvā prayaccati śubha aśubham
verses.translation: "Have you no fear of death that you dare address me thus rudely, I whose tongue that you dare tongue dispenses good and evil?"

verses.devanagari:
अपि एव दहनम् स्पृष्ट्वा वने तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः |
राज दोष परामृष्टास् तिष्ठन्ते न अपराधिनः
verses.iast:
api eva dahanam spṛṣṭvā vane tiṣṭhanti pādapāḥ |
rāja doṣa parāmṛṣṭās tiṣṭhante na aparādhinaḥ
verses.translation: "Trees may survive in the forest, even if disturbed by fire. But the guilty cannot survive, if touched by the royal scepter."

glosses.meaning: if touched by the royal scepter.

verses.devanagari:
हन्याम् अहम् इमौ पापौ शत्रु पक्ष प्रशंसकौ |
यदि पूर्व उपकारैर् मे न क्रोधो मृदुताम् व्रजेत्
verses.iast:
hanyām aham imau pāpau śatru pakṣa praśaṃsakau |
yadi pūrva upakārair me na krodho mṛdutām vrajet
verses.translation: "If my anger is not softened by the services they rendered earlier, I would have killed thse two miscreants who are praising the band of enemies."

glosses.meaning: by the services they rendered earlier
who are praising the band of enemies.

verses.devanagari:
अपध्वंसत गच्चध्वम् सम्निकर्षाद् इतो मम |
न हि वाम् हन्तुम् इच्चामि स्मरन्न् उपकृतानि वाम्
हताव् एव कृतघ्नौ तौ मयि स्नेह परान् मुखौ |
verses.iast:
apadhvaṃsata gaccadhvam samnikarṣād ito mama |
na hi vām hantum iccāmi smarann upakṛtāni vām
hatāv eva kṛtaghnau tau mayi sneha parān mukhau |
verses.translation: "Keep away from my neighbourhood. Do not be seen anywhere here. I am recollecting your past services and hence do not wish to kill you. Both of you, who are ungrateful and unfaithful towards me, are just as dead to me."

glosses.meaning: do not be seen anywhere here

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तौ तु सव्रीडौ ताव् उभौ शुक सारणौ
रावणम् जय शब्देन प्रतिनन्द्य अभिनिह्सृतौ |
verses.iast:
evam uktau tu savrīḍau tāv ubhau śuka sāraṇau
rāvaṇam jaya śabdena pratinandya abhinihsṛtau |
verses.translation: Hearing Ravana's words, Shuka and Sarana felt ashamed to see Ravana paid obeisance to him saying, "Be thou victorious!" and went away.

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीत् स दशग्रीवः समीपस्थम् महाउदरम्
उपस्थापय शीघ्रम् मे चारान् नीति विशारदान् |
verses.iast:
abravīt sa daśagrīvaḥ samīpastham mahāudaram
upasthāpaya śīghram me cārān nīti viśāradān |
verses.translation: The demon Ravana spoke to Mahodara who was standing nearby as follows: "Bring me the spies here quickly."

glosses.meaning: who was standing nearby (as follows):- upasthaaya = bring

verses.devanagari:
महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तु शीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान्
ततश्चाराः सम्त्वरिताः प्राप्ताः पार्थिवशासनात् |
उपस्थिथाः प्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषः
verses.iast:
mahodarastathoktastu śīghramājJṇāpayaccarān
tataścārāḥ samtvaritāḥ prāptāḥ pārthivaśāsanāt |
upasthithāḥ prāJṇjalayo vardhayitvā jayāśiṣaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words, Mahodara immediately ordered for the spies. The spies came hurriedly as per the orders of the king, paid obeisance to him by joining their palms and approached him, having made a complement expressing their desire to see him victorious.

glosses.meaning: as per the order of the king
paid obeisance by joining their palms
expressing their desire to see him victorious.

verses.devanagari:
तान् अब्रवीत् ततो वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः
चारान् प्रत्ययिकान् शूरान् भक्तान् विगत साध्वसान् |
verses.iast:
tān abravīt tato vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ
cārān pratyayikān śūrān bhaktān vigata sādhvasān |
verses.translation: Then, Ravana the king of demons spoke the following words to those spies, who were faithful, brave, energetic and free from fear:

verses.devanagari:
इतो गच्चत रामस्य व्यवसायम् परीक्षथ
मन्त्रेष्व् अभ्यन्तरा ये अस्य प्रीत्या तेन समागताः |
verses.iast:
ito gaccata rāmasya vyavasāyam parīkṣatha
mantreṣv abhyantarā ye asya prītyā tena samāgatāḥ |
verses.translation: "You go from here to investigate about the first impression concerning Rama, as regards who are his intimate friends and in respect of those who joined on his side with a liking towards him."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् स्वपिति जागर्ति किम् अन्यच् च करिष्यति
विज्ञाय निपुणम् सर्वम् आगन्तव्यम् अशेषतः |
verses.iast:
katham svapiti jāgarti kim anyac ca kariṣyati
viGYāya nipuṇam sarvam āgantavyam aśeṣataḥ |
verses.translation: "Find out what are his hours of sleeping and waking and what he intends to do next. You ought to come here, after acquainting with all this information completely and skillfully."

glosses.meaning: sleeping? Jaagarti = and waking up? Kim = what
now? Aagantavyam = you ought to come

verses.devanagari:
चारेण विदितः शत्रुः पण्डितैर् वसुधा अधिपैः
युद्धे स्वल्पेन यत्नेन समासाद्य निरस्यते |
verses.iast:
cāreṇa viditaḥ śatruḥ paṇḍitair vasudhā adhipaiḥ
yuddhe svalpena yatnena samāsādya nirasyate |
verses.translation: "An enemy in battle, got known through spies by kings, will be defeated with only a little of effort."

verses.devanagari:
चारास् तु ते तथा इति उक्त्वा प्रहृष्टा राक्षस ईश्वरम्
शार्दूलमग्रतः कृत्वा ततश्चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणम् |
verses.iast:
cārās tu te tathā iti uktvā prahṛṣṭā rākṣasa īśvaram
śārdūlamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataścakruḥ pradakśiṇam |
verses.translation: Those spies on their part delightfully replied, "May it be so", kept Shardula in their front and made their circumambulation clockwise around Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तम् तु महात्मानम् चारा राक्षससत्तमम्
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् जग्मुर् यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः |
verses.iast:
tatastam tu mahātmānam cārā rākśasasattamam
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam jagmur yatra rāmaḥ salakśmaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Having thus made circumambulation to Ravana the excellent and the distinguished demon, the spies went to the place where Rama along with Lakshmana were there.

verses.devanagari:
ते सुवेलस्य शैलस्य समीपे राम लक्ष्मणौ
प्रच्चन्ना ददृशुर् गत्वा ससुग्रीव विभीषणौ |
verses.iast:
te suvelasya śailasya samīpe rāma lakṣmaṇau
praccannā dadṛśur gatvā sasugrīva vibhīṣaṇau |
verses.translation: Having gone in a disguised manner, those spies saw Rama and Lakshman together with Sugreeva and Vibhishana in the neighbourhood of Mountain Suvela.

verses.devanagari:
प्रेक्षमाणाश्चमूम् ताम् च बभूवुर्भयविह्वलाः
ते तु धर्म आत्मना दृष्टा राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसाः |
verses.iast:
prekśamāṇāścamūm tām ca babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ
te tu dharma ātmanā dṛṣṭā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasāḥ |
verses.translation: Seeing that army, those demons became overwhelmed with fear. However, they were observed by the high-souled Vibhishana the Lord of demons.

glosses.meaning: by Vibhishana the Lord of demons

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणेन तत्रस्था निगृहीता यदृच्चया
शार्दूलो ग्राहितस्त्वेकः पापोऽयमिति राक्षसः |
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇena tatrasthā nigṛhītā yadṛccayā
śārdūlo grāhitastvekaḥ pāpo'yamiti rākśasaḥ |
verses.translation: Accidentally, the deomons there were caught by Vibhishana, who said that the demon Shardula among them was wicked and got him alone seized.

verses.devanagari:
मोक्षितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः प्लवङ्गमैः
अनृशंसेन रामेण मोक्षिता राक्षसाः सरे |
verses.iast:
mokśitaḥ so'pi rāmeṇa vadhyamānaḥ plavaṇ^gamaiḥ
anṛśaṃsena rāmeṇa mokśitā rākśasāḥ sare |
verses.translation: That Shardula also, who was going to be killed by the monkeys, was got released by Rama. The other demons also were got released by Rama, the kind man.

glosses.meaning: who was about to be killed

verses.devanagari:
वानरैर् अर्दितास् ते तु विक्रान्तैर् लघु विक्रमैः
पुनर् लंकाम् अनुप्राप्ताः श्वसन्तो नष्ट चेतसः |
verses.iast:
vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghu vikramaiḥ
punar laṃkām anuprāptāḥ śvasanto naṣṭa cetasaḥ |
verses.translation: Those demons, harassed by the courageous and the quick-paced monkeys, became insensible, heaved a sigh and reached back Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
ततो दशग्रीवम् उपस्थितास् ते |
चारा बहिर् नित्य चरा निशा चराः |
गिरेः सुवेलस्य समीप वासिनम् |
न्यवेदयन् भीम बलम् महाबलाः
verses.iast:
tato daśagrīvam upasthitās te |
cārā bahir nitya carā niśā carāḥ |
gireḥ suvelasya samīpa vāsinam |
nyavedayan bhīma balam mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Those spies, who always wander outside and who were valiant rangers of the night, thereafter approached Ravana and informed him that Rama's army was camping in the vicinity of the Suvela mountain.
